tagline: RLI Corp. is a U.S.-based specialty insurance company that underwrites select property, casualty and surety products through three major subsidiaries, achieving 30 consecutive years of underwriting profitability.
hero_kpi_rationale: RLI has achieved 30 consecutive years of underwriting profitability, demonstrating exceptional risk management and niche strategy in the specialty insurance sector.

kpis.name: Underwriting Profitability
kpis.explanation: Profit before taxes generated by insurance operations.
kpis.description: Measures the profitability of insurance activities by subtracting losses, acquisition costs and operating expenses from net premiums earned.

kpis.name: Combined Ratio
kpis.explanation: Key indicator of underwriting profitability in insurance.
kpis.description: Sum of loss ratio and expense ratio, indicating the profitability of underwriting operations. A ratio below 100% signals profitability.

kpis.name: Net Premiums Earned
kpis.explanation: Total insurance premium revenue after deduction of reinsurance.
kpis.description: Represents the amount of insurance premiums earned by the company during the period.

kpis.name: Loss Ratio
kpis.explanation: Percentage of premiums used to pay claims.
kpis.description: Calculated by dividing losses and claims settlement expenses by net premiums earned.

kpis.name: Expense Ratio
kpis.explanation: Percentage of premiums used to cover operating and acquisition costs.
kpis.description: Sum of policy acquisition costs and insurance operating expenses, divided by net premiums earned.

kpis.name: Net Investment Income
kpis.explanation: Income generated by the company's investment portfolio.
kpis.description: Income from the company's investments, excluding realized or unrealized gains or losses.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).

risks.title: Industry Fluctuations and Results Volatility
risks.score_rationale: This risk is featured at the top of the 10-K, described as a fundamental cause of results volatility and security price fluctuations. The language emphasizes historical uncertainty and multiple exogenous factors. The 'Industrial' category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Dependence on Key Brokers
risks.score_rationale: 49% of premiums derive from 10 entities. The document highlights a 'material' risk in case of loss of these partners. Central position in the report, strong language ('adversely affect').

risks.title: Geographic Concentration of Risks
risks.score_rationale: 56% of premiums from 4 States, including Florida and California, exposed to catastrophes. Risk described as 'disproportionate'. Concerned language on regulatory or operational impacts.

risks.title: Inadequacy of Loss Reserves
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed at length, with mention of uncertainty 'inherently uncertain' and effects 'materially adverse'. Reserves are central to an insurer's financial health, 'Credit' category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Unpredictable Catastrophic Losses
risks.score_rationale: Strong language: 'material financial losses', 'unpredictable', 'substantial volatility'. Existential risk for insurers. Models deemed imperfect. High position in the document.

risks.title: Increasing Climate Change Impacts
risks.score_rationale: Risk well developed, with multiple effects: claims, models, regulation, energy transition. Cautious but concerned language: 'cannot predict the cumulative impact'. Important macro category.

risks.title: Decline in Financial Ratings
risks.score_rationale: Ratings are described as 'important' for competitive position. A downgrade could result in 'substantial loss of business'. Mention of three major agencies, preventive yet serious language.

risks.title: Increased or Evolving Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Long list of regulatory constraints, with risk of sanctions: 'fines', 'suspensions'. Mention of AI and data governance. Repetitive and detailed language, indicating a structural risk.

ai_positioning.summary: RLI Corp. does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report. The information provided focuses on the company's financial and operational aspects, with no reference to AI.
